title: At least one element above b
prompt: Specification: count_pairs(xs, m, b) returns the number of pairs i < j such that (xs[i] + xs[j]) is divisible by m and at least one of xs[i], xs[j] is strictly greater than b. Select the implementation that satisfies the specification.

recommendation.text: Implementation B is correct. It uses `or`, so a pair is counted when at least one value is greater than b.
